language.title: Choose your language
language.body: You can change this any time in Settings.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.body: We will send a code to confirm it is you.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.badCode: That code is not correct. Please try again.
phone.failed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.
phone.localCode: Enter the sign-in code set up for this app. No text message is sent in this setup.

consent.title: What may Healix use?
consent.body: Nothing is switched on until you say so. You can change this any time.

triage.title: Understand my symptoms
triage.body: Healix reads what you describe to suggest a specialist.

reports.title: Read my reports
reports.body: Healix reads your lab reports to explain them in simple words.

location.title: Use my location
location.body: Used only to find nearby doctors and in an emergency.

voice.title: Listen and speak
voice.body: Your voice is sent to Sarvam AI to turn it into text, and text is read aloud.

consent.needOne: Switch on at least one to continue.

profile.title: Who is this for?
profile.body: Add a parent or family member to manage their care from your phone.
profile.name: Name
profile.elder: Use large text and simple screens

home.speakOrType: Speak or type, in your own language.
home.askHint: Understand the words in your report

triage.title: Tell Healix how you feel
triage.errorTitle: We could not check this right now

emergency.title: Get emergency help now
emergency.holdToShare: Hold to share my location and details
emergency.holdHint: Hold for 2 seconds. The hospital gets your location and a short summary.
emergency.sentBody: They know you are coming. Estimated arrival in about {{minutes}} min.
emergency.failed: Could not send. Please call 102 now.
emergency.usingSaved: Location is off, so your saved area was used.
emergency.publicNote: You are not signed in, so only calling and the nearest hospital are shown here.
emergency.signIn: Sign in to alert the hospital with your details
emergency.noLocation: Allow your location to see the nearest emergency department.

doctors.title: Doctors near you
doctors.emptyHint: Try a wider distance or a higher fee.
doctors.errorTitle: We could not load doctors right now

bestTime.title: Best time to visit
bestTime.note: Typical waits at this doctor, from past visits.

form.title: Booking details
form.intro: Tell us what you need, then pick from doctors near you.

booking.title: Choose a time
booking.noSlots: No free times left for this day.
booking.failed: We could not book this right now. Please try again.
booking.tokenFailed: Your time is booked, but we could not get your token yet.
booking.noneLeft: This doctor has no free times left.
booking.notExactWindow: No time was free in your preferred slot, so this is the closest time on that day.
booking.notExactDate: Nothing was free on your chosen date, so this is the next free time.

token.noTokenBody: Book a doctor to get a token and a time to leave home.
token.delayLonger: It is now about {{minutes}} min longer than before.
token.delayShorter: It is now about {{minutes}} min shorter than before.
token.called: It is your turn. Please go to {{room}}.
token.spoken: Leave home in {{minutes}} minutes, by {{time}}. Your token is {{label}}.
token.spokenNow: Time to leave now. Your token is {{label}}.
token.error: We could not load this token.

swap.ask: Ask the person ahead to swap
swap.title: Swap places
swap.body: Pick a token ahead of yours. They see only your token number, never your name.
swap.declined: {{label}} said no. You can ask someone else.
swap.limit: All {{max}} requests for this token are used.
swap.waitFirst: Wait for the current request to be answered first.
swap.nobody: Nobody is waiting ahead of you.
swap.incomingTitle: Someone behind you asks to swap
swap.incomingBody: Token {{from}} would like your place. You would move to {{to}}.
swap.failed: We could not send the request. Please try again.
swap.respondFailed: We could not send your answer. Please try again.

list.title: My reports
list.error: We could not load your reports right now.
list.emptyHint: Upload a lab report and Healix explains it in simple words.

upload.title: Upload a report
upload.body: Take a clear photo or choose a report. Healix reads it, and you check what it found before anything is explained.
upload.consent: Healix needs to read your lab report to explain it. Nothing is read until you allow it.
upload.consentFailed: We could not save your choice. Please try again.
upload.failed: We could not read this report. A clearer, well-lit photo usually helps. Please try again.
upload.badType: Please choose a photo, a PDF, a Word file or a text file.
upload.tooBig: This file is too large. Please choose one under 50 MB.
upload.formats: Photos, PDFs, Word and text files, up to 50 MB.
upload.privacy: Your report is used only to explain it to you. You can remove it any time.
upload.failedUnreadable: We could not open this file. Please choose a photo, a PDF, a Word file or a text file.
upload.failedNoText: We could not find any readable text. A clearer, well-lit photo usually helps.
upload.failedScanned: This PDF is a scan and could not be read. Please upload a clear photo or screenshot of the pages instead.

review.title: Check the values
review.body: Healix read these values from your report. Fix anything that looks wrong before it is explained.
review.confirmFailed: We could not confirm the values. Please try again.
review.error: We could not open this report.
review.notReady: This report is still being read. Please come back in a moment.
review.imageFailed: The report picture could not be loaded.
review.noValues: Healix could not find standard lab values in this document, so there is nothing to check here. It is kept as it is, and you can ask Healix AI questions about what it says.
review.docPreview: This file type cannot be previewed here, but it was read.

explain.reviewFirst: Healix explains a report only once its values are confirmed.
explain.error: We could not load this explanation.
explain.duplicate: You had this test {{days}} days ago. Ask your doctor whether repeating it is needed.
explain.askAssistant: Ask Healix AI about a word in this report

assistant.title: Healix AI
assistant.intro: I explain your reports in simple language and answer everyday health questions. I cannot diagnose or suggest medicines.

starters.summary: Explain my report in simple words

assistant.placeholder: Ask about your report or a health word
assistant.failed: We could not get an answer right now. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.elderHint: Bigger text, a simpler home screen and results read aloud when voice is on.
settings.consentHint: Switch any of these off and Healix stops using it straight away.
settings.consentFailed: We could not save that change. Please try again.
settings.privacyBody: Your health details stay on the server, never in this browser. Only your language and large-text choice are remembered on this device.

profileForm.myDetailsHint: Healix uses these to tailor advice. You can change them any time in Settings.
profileForm.familyHint: Add someone you look after. Each person has their own reports, tokens and bookings.
profileForm.name: Full name
profileForm.conditionsHint: Tick any that apply. Leave empty if none.
profileForm.failed: We could not save this. Please try again.

community.title: Community
community.intro: Read and share experiences with people who live with the same condition. You appear under a nickname.
community.guidelines: Community members are not doctors. Please do not share phone numbers, links or medicine doses. For urgent symptoms call 102 or 112.
community.emptyHint: Be the first to share something helpful.
community.error: We could not load the community right now.
community.noReplies: No replies yet. Be the first to help.
community.replyPlaceholder: Share your experience or a kind word…
community.reported: Thank you. We will review this post.
community.postTitlePlaceholder: What would you like to share or ask?
community.postBodyPlaceholder: Tell your story or ask your question in a few lines.
community.titleShort: Please write a title of at least 4 characters.

problem.phone: Please remove phone numbers to keep everyone private.
problem.email: Please remove email addresses to keep everyone private.
problem.dose: Please remove medicine doses. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about those.

community.slowDown: You are posting very quickly. Please wait a little.
community.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again to post.
community.offline: We cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
community.failed: We could not post this. Please try again.

tokenView.sampleNote: This is how your token will look. Book a doctor to get your own.

booked.title: Token booked
booked.body: Your place in the queue is saved.

queue.title: Waiting your turn
queue.body: You can wait at home. Healix tells you when to leave.

turn.title: Called in
turn.body: Go to the room shown on your token.

done.title: Visit finished
done.body: Your reports and questions can go with you next time.
